verses.text: A song of ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!

xrefs.text: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.
then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.

verses.text: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.

xrefs.text: He also poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.
Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.
Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.
Oil and incense bring joy to the heart, and the counsel of a friend is sweetness to the soul.
They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.

verses.text: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.

xrefs.text: The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
But I will send My blessing upon you in the sixth year, so that the land will yield a crop sufficient for three years.
The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
extending from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),
And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
